correctness.rationale: The complete update map on all 3^12 = 531441 encoded states is constructed from the 24 displayed edges. Functional-graph indegree elimination exhausts all cycles and reverses all transient paths; a separate memoized trajectory implementation using independent local transition evaluation agrees on every one of 52 joint time-period classes. All primitive cycle counts, 64 maximally delayed states, and explicit eight automorphism witnesses were checked against actual packaged programs, including vertex-edge preservation and distinct images of one eleven-cycle. The eleven-cycles each exhibit exactly three excitations per vertex over eleven updates; this was checked directly from all eight explicit cycles.

value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is the canonical extremal smallest triangle-free four-regular four-chromatic graph, so its full nonlinear excitation response is a motivated natural benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Its eight prime-period eleven temporal cycles collapse to one spatial symmetry orbit, and the sharp extremal ten-update basin splits between periods three and eleven. Neither detail follows just from graph regularity, chromatic number, or the known maximum-cycle-density criterion. A complete fixed-graph census is valuable as an exact classified nonlinear dynamical example, without pretending to be a theorem for all regular graphs.
